hold_overrides.rationale: The glosses separate the mental act of retaining past events from the remembered content that returns to mind, so merging would erase a useful process-versus-content distinction. Neither sense has an authored relation route, however, so the second Typewriter boundary condition is not demonstrated. Keep both senses pending concrete writer-facing relation direction or target-POS evidence.
